name: team-read-coordination
title: 统一同页摘要和正文读取，有限重试外部读取繁忙
constraints: Independent worktree; preserve other authors' edits and do not merge main independently
No production HTTP, SQL, model call, service maintenance or approval
Do not weaken backend worker lifetime, exact source fences, complete history or approval contracts
Incremental Node and relevant real Chrome tests only
rollback: Revert frontend assets and this read-scheduling contract, refresh browser; no SQL, journal, operation, approval or worktree migration.
authorization: Root authorized implementation after actual refresh-chain offline RED; root owns integration/deployment.
